shots.h3_prompt:
Subject and scene: In a fictional amber-lit workshop, an elderly clockmaker tightens one brass screw on a palm-sized mechanical bird. The bird wakes, tests both wings, and lands beside a blue enamel teacup.
Camera: stable cinematic composition with one motivated movement.
0-3s: establish the subject, location, and current prop state.
3-7s: perform the central action with physically coherent motion.
7-10s: resolve the action while preserving identity and scene continuity.
Sound: natural synchronized ambience and action sounds; no narration unless requested.
